name: The Smiler
description: The world record holder for most inversions with 14 loops, corkscrews and barrel rolls at 85 km/h. A truly relentless and disorienting experience unlike anything else.

name: Nemesis
description: A legendary B&M inverted coaster carved into the natural rock landscape at 80 km/h with four inversions. Europe's first inverted coaster opened in 1994 and still one of the best.

name: Oblivion
description: The world's first vertical drop roller coaster plunging riders straight down at 109 km/h into an underground tunnel. An iconic and terrifying experience that defined a generation.

name: Wicker Man
description: The UK's first major wooden roller coaster in over 20 years combining real fire effects with thrilling wooden coaster thrills through a pagan Celtic themed setting at 72 km/h.

name: Rita
description: A powerful hydraulic launched coaster accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in just 2.5 seconds through a series of sharp turns and twists.

name: Thirteen
description: A unique family thriller combining a traditional roller coaster with a sudden unexpected freefall drop in total darkness deep into the haunted forest beneath the ride.

name: Hex
description: A mysterious dark ride set inside the ancient Alton Towers mansion ruins featuring a spectacular rotating chamber illusion and ghostly storytelling.

name: Gangsta Granny: The Ride
description: An exciting indoor dark ride adventure based on the popular David Walliams story, taking families on a thrilling heist through humorous themed scenes.

name: Raft of the Roaring Nineties
description: A classic river rapids ride spinning through churning white water on circular rafts with exciting splashes and soaking drops perfect for a hot day.

name: Spinball Whizzer
description: A fun spinning family roller coaster themed around a giant pinball machine, sending riders through loops and turns in freely rotating cars at 45 km/h.
